funnel_rule: Cheap terminal blockers stop expensive downstream work. A stage FAIL is terminal for the current pin: no downstream spend is authorized. Later stages are still evaluated diagnostically (to map the full gap set) but cannot overturn the terminal verdict.

output_shape.qualification_burden: estimate band where defensible, else UNKNOWN

provider_neutrality: No stage may require XMage Java APIs, Forge controller class names, specific UUID formats, one engine RNG method, or one engine callback taxonomy. Semantic capabilities only; each provider supplies a mapping layer.

S0.rule: PASS iff commit+tree+license(SPDX)+build-or-adapter identity are all recorded and verifiable. Missing identity => FAIL (terminal).

S1.rule: PASS iff sole-Rules-authority design AND legal-action surface inventory AND fail-closed unsupported-path design AND principal-scoped observation design are all present at CODE_DERIVED minimum. A PROVEN whole-boundary violation (e.g. prohibited defaults in the production-reachable path) => FAIL terminal. Absent inventory (never performed) => UNKNOWN (insufficient evidence, still terminal for the pin).

S2.rule: PASS iff 2P-5P constructible AND Commander/multiplayer semantics viable at CODE_DERIVED minimum. A PROVEN init block (e.g. Partner unconstructible) is recorded as S3-relevant gap; S2 FAIL only if cardinalities themselves unconstructible.

S3.rule: PASS iff frozen SUPPORTED==29 with one dedicated behavior test inventoried per CARD_* fixture (DIRECTLY_VERIFIED census grade; execution deferred to S5) AND micro implemented==17 with zero blocked areas. Anything less => FAIL terminal (proven gap) — this is the cheap denominator screen that protects weeks of qualification spend.

S4.rule: PASS iff Rules RNG attribution design AND a bounded clean-process semantic-replay runtime proof (minimum one tape + independent clean-process replay, WS218-Tape-v1 shape) exist. Design without runtime proof => FAIL terminal (missing required runtime proof). Slot/in-process-only replay => FAIL terminal.

S5.rule: PASS iff all 135 mandatory fixtures PASS with RUNTIME_VERIFIED under the current manifest at the candidate pin. Anything less => FAIL terminal. S5 PASS is the ONLY promotion event into full qualification (decision campaigns, provider selection track).

stages.name: Source, license and build identity
stages.purpose: Bind exactly what would be qualified; reject unidentified code.

stages.name: Architecture, Rules authority, legal-action and hidden-info feasibility
stages.purpose: Prove the engine CAN be sole Rules authority with a mappable legal surface and principal-safe observations before spending runtime.

stages.name: Bounded cardinality and Commander/multiplayer viability
stages.purpose: Prove 2P-5P plus Commander/multiplayer semantics are constructible before denominator spend.

stages.name: Frozen-card and micro-rules denominator screen
stages.purpose: Cheap census-grade screen: 29/29 SUPPORTED inventory + 17/17 micro implemented. Terminal for both WS219 pins.

stages.name: RNG and replay feasibility
stages.purpose: Bounded runtime proof of Rules RNG attribution + clean-process semantic replay (one tape minimum), not the full campaign.

terminal_blocker_semantics: First FAIL in S0..S5 order is the terminal blocker. UNKNOWN at any stage (insufficient evidence, e.g. census never performed) is equally terminal for the pin (DO_NOT_PROMOTE_CURRENT_PIN with blocker_kind MISSING_EVIDENCE) but prescribes inventory work rather than upstream implementation.
